findings.text: the else branch labels every verdict but congested as an open gate, so a published admission block carrying verdict full or paused, both of which this node's own goal names in the vocabulary, gets a reason contradicting its verdict: reproduced as admission block with verdict paused and headroom -1 returning the reason admission headroom is -1 (published admission headroom); the gate is open, and verdict full with headroom 0 returning the same open claim.
